independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the trigger row, its caret and the panel insets.

intent: Show or hide one section of content under a labelled trigger

properties.description: Whether the panel is shown. Setting it (attribute or property) fires no openchange; a trigger press sets it unless openchange is canceled.
Open at first connect when no open attribute is present (Base UI defaultOpen).
Ignores trigger presses; the trigger leaves the tab order (aria-disabled). Inside a disabled ui-accordion every item is disabled.
Text of a generated trigger (the preset form). Ignored when an authored trigger has its own text.
The item value inside a ui-accordion (its value list names open items); defaults to the item index. Unused outside an accordion.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: the trigger is pressed (pointer, Enter or Space); preventDefault keeps the panel as it is

sources: the trigger's text (label or authored trigger content)

content.children: Panel content (any elements), or authored [data-part=trigger] and [data-part=panel] children. Elements with slot=leading | prefix | suffix | trailing (direct children in the preset, or inside an authored trigger) fill the trigger's construction-pattern parts.

constraints: The panel stays in the DOM and is hidden while closed; its contents are not focusable or found by find-in-page then.
The trailing slot holds a caret-down icon unless the author fills it; the caret turns 180° while open.
Height animates in CSS (interpolate-size); browsers without it open and close at once. Reduced motion collapses the duration.
Setting open from script changes the panel without an openchange event.

avoidWhen.when: Several sections of which the user opens one or a few at a time.
avoidWhen.reason: An accordion coordinates the items (single or multiple open) and moves focus between their triggers.

avoidWhen.when: Switching between peer views of the same area.
avoidWhen.reason: Peer views are tabs: one panel shows at a time and the list names every view.

avoidWhen.when: Content that floats over the page next to its trigger.
avoidWhen.reason: A collapsible pushes the content below it; the kit has no popover or menu component yet.

nodes.summary: The trigger row (role=button, aria-expanded, aria-controls; data-panel-open while open): the construction pattern with a caret in trailing. Base UI Collapsible.Trigger.
The panel (data-open / data-closed; hidden while closed), its height animated on the reveal intent. Base UI Collapsible.Panel.
